data.narrative:
Liminal Insights is a Series A–stage climate and energy technology company founded by Barry Van Tassell and Shaurjo Biswas. The company has raised $38.9M to date. The relevant peer universe comprises one public company (LNZA) and eight private-sector peers in climate and energy, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given the company's defined Series A status. Using total capital raised ($39M) as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $78M. A peer-median approach was not viable; while eight same-sector peers exist, none met the stringency threshold of at least three datapoints in matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $66M (low) to $89M (high), with a median point of $78M. The range reflects typical variance around stage-progression estimates absent sufficient narrow-peer triangulation. Key uncertainties include the lack of direct same-stage comparables in this subsector, reliance on a single methodological anchor, and stage-specific capital efficiency relative to broader climate tech cohorts. Additional disclosure of unit economics and revenue run-rate would narrow this range materially.
